protocol.source_split: All 555 raw source excerpts: pass1 train200, pass2 calibration200, pass3 test155. No original-source interval overlap across roles.
protocol.scope: Different takes of the same instrument/session; not different-session or performer generalization.
protocol.ordinary: Reuses training source takes; descriptive stress score, not independent validation.
protocol.template: One median of nine source-contained crops per pass-1 note/string cell; 200 atoms. Dense linear FFT magnitude, 20..12000Hz, trailing Hann4096/16384.
protocol.solver: Train-template whitening floor 0.01*peak mean-square; unit atom norm; ridge0.001 NNLS via equivalent augmented QR; sum by note, divide by strongest pitch.
protocol.cutoff: One global train-only fit: maximize true positives at precision>=99%; strictest tie, positive values only, equal values indivisible. If infeasible, all-off and fail. Persist before any held-out evaluation.
protocol.primary_clock: Measured serial FIFO completion including dense FFT, NNLS and threshold cost; source availability diagnostic only.
protocol.representation_gate: Both calibration and test: precision>=95%, recall>=80%, exact_set>=70%.
protocol.conditional_execution: Skip both continuous recordings unless both held-out representation gates and train cutoff feasibility pass.
protocol.replacement_research_gate: Ordinary>=5pp, and every existing per-label and wrong/gap/exact-set/all-expected nonregression clause on both datasets.
protocol.strata: Related if any two distinct truth pitches differ by 12/19/24/28/31/36; all other examples separate. Report-only; no policy branch.
protocol.no_tuning: No retraining, parameter sweep, test-driven cutoff or repeated dispatch. Full rank ridge NNLS failure fails the job.
protocol.limitations: Magnitude additivity is approximate with coherent overlap. Same session sustain mixtures, all intended labels retained. Pitch presence only, no live/lane/MIDI proof.
